jordan (sales): Hey team — prospect (FinReg) pushed back on the SIG asking for privileged access / admin controls evidence. They want: admin role separation, MFA enforcement for admin actions, service account rotation, JIT/admin approval flow, and audit logs. Can we pull together what to send by EOD?

maria (eng-security): We have a short bundle. I'll list the items and where they live.

maria (eng-security): 1) SSO + SAML config + attribute mappings (Okta). 2) MFA policy screenshots for admin OU. 3) RBAC role matrix (names + least-privilege rationale). 4) Service account rotation policy (Vault) + sample rotation logs. 5) Audit log extraction for last 90 days.

samir (solutions): For the SIG they'll accept screenshots + exported logs. If they ask for live demo we can spin a scoped demo org.

jordan (sales): Good. Which artifacts are easiest to produce quickly? They asked specifically for an example of the SAML assertion attributes used to map to our roles.

maria (eng-security): Quick SAML snippet (Okta mapping) — use this mapping for role claims: 
```xml
<saml:Attribute Name=\"roles\"> 
  <saml:AttributeValue>redwood_admin</saml:AttributeValue>
  <saml:AttributeValue>redwood_viewer</saml:AttributeValue>
</saml:Attribute>
```
We also add group->role SCIM sync for org teams.

maria (eng-security): MFA enforcement: Okta policy "Require MFA for Admins" applied to group okta_redwood_admins (since 2023-10-12). Screenshot: /internal/security/artifacts/mfa_admin_policy.png

alex (sales-eng): For service accounts: rotation via HashiCorp Vault with periodic TTL 30d and forced rotation on credential compromise. We can export rotation events. Example query to pull rotation logs from SIEM: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_TOKEN" "https://logs.redwood.internal/api/v1/search?q=event:service_account_rotation&from=-90d"
```

maria (eng-security): JIT/admin approval: we use a short-lived elevation flow for a subset of roles. Approvals recorded in the ticket system (Jira link) and gated by Okta group membership. We can provide a redacted approval transcript and a sample policy.

samir (solutions): RBAC matrix — I'll attach the spreadsheet with roles->perms and least-privilege justification. Prefer sending CSV + one screenshot of the roles page.

jordan (sales): Prospect also asked whether Dedicated (reserved capacity) supports scoping roles so their SREs can only see their project instances (multi-tenant control plane). Need a short answer for SOC reviewer.

maria (eng-security): Yes — Dedicated uses tenant-scoped role bindings. We can provide an architecture diagram + sample policy snippet showing project-scoped bindings. Diagram link: https://confluence.redwood.com/pages/dedicated-rbac. Policy sample: `bind role:project-admin -> group:customer-acme-admins (scope: project:acme-prod)`.

alex (sales-eng): I'll compile screenshots + logs into a zip. Question: are we ok to share redacted audit logs (they want user identifiers masked)?

maria (eng-security): Yes, share redacted logs. We have a sanitized export pipeline. Use `scripts/sanitize_audit_export.sh` to remove PII.

maria (eng-security): Example log extraction command (for eng SREs):
```
# export last 90 days of audit events
python tools/export_audit.py --from="-90d" --type=admin_actions --out=admin_audit_90d.json
# then sanitize
./scripts/sanitize_audit_export.sh admin_audit_90d.json > admin_audit_90d_sanitized.json
```

security-bot: artifact-upload: preview.zip uploaded to /internal/security/uploads/1954321000-preview.zip :white_check_mark:

jordan (sales): Perfect — can we have the final package by 5pm PT? I'll feed it to their vendor risk team. Also they asked about MFA enforcement frequency for console vs API keys.

maria (eng-security): Console MFA enforced always for admin sessions. API keys are rotated and tied to service accounts; require rotation TTL and vault retrieval (no console MFA). We document compensating controls in the package.

samir (solutions): I'll add a short note on how to configure least-privilege for dedicated capacity (policy examples + canary rollout pattern).

alex (sales-eng): On it — uploading final zip in ~70m.

jordan (sales): Thanks everyone :pray: I'll ping if they want a live walkthrough.

maria (eng-security): FYI — if the SIG reviewer bumps to CAIQ full, flag me asap. Some items will need longer evidence collection.

jordan (sales): noted.

alex (sales-eng): uploaded: 1954321000-redwood-priv-access-package.zip -> /sfdc/attachments/1954321000.

jordan (sales): Received. Sending to customer now. :rocket:
